Name: Premium Craft Beer Mod
Author: FreSny
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Premium Craft Beer Mod adds five handcrafted beers to Stardew Valley, each with unique effects and a complete production chain. From growing ingredients to crafting brewing materials and aging them in kegs, every beer tells its own story.

精酿啤酒 Mod 为星露谷物语添加五款精心酿造的精酿啤酒，每款都有独特的效果和完整的生产链。从种植原料到合成酿材，再到小桶酿造，每一款啤酒都有属于自己的故事。

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install SMAPI (https://smapi.io/)
2. Install Content Patcher (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915)
3. Download and extract this mod
4. Place both the "PremiumBeerMod" and "PremiumBeerData" folders into your Stardew Valley/Mods/ folder
5. Launch the game via SMAPI

安装步骤：
1. 安装 SMAPI
2. 安装 Content Patcher
3. 下载并解压本 Mod
4. 将 "PremiumBeerMod" 和 "PremiumBeerData" 两个文件夹放入 Stardew Valley/Mods/ 文件夹
5. 通过 SMAPI 启动游戏[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]🍺 Five Unique Craft Beers:
- Paulaner Munich Helles: Dynamic effect — costs 5 energy when energized, restores 10 energy when tired, and removes exhaustion
- Corona Extra: Restores 330 energy, grants +3 Speed for 40 seconds
- Double IPA: Restores 230 energy, grants +1 Speed for 60 seconds
- Guinness Draught: Restores 280 energy, grants +3 Luck for 40 seconds
- Belgian White (Witbier): Restores 170 energy, grants +1 Luck for 40 seconds

🌾 Complete Production Chain:
- Craft brewing ingredients at the Crafting Menu using Hops, Wheat, Sugar, and Spice Berry
- Place ingredients into Kegs to brew beer (3–7 in-game days)

⚙️ Data-Driven Design:
- All item data, recipes, and textures are defined via Content Patcher JSON
- Easy to customize or extend

🍺 五款独特的精酿啤酒：
- 保拉纳柏龙啤酒：动态效果——精力充沛时消耗5体力，疲劳时恢复10体力，并消除疲惫
- 科罗娜啤酒：恢复330能量，+3速度，持续40秒
- 双倍IPA啤酒：恢复230能量，+1速度，持续60秒
- 健力士黑啤酒：恢复280能量，+3运气，持续40秒
- 比利时白啤酒：恢复170能量，+1运气，持续40秒

🌾 完整生产链：
- 在制造台使用啤酒花、小麦、糖和香味浆果合成酿材
- 将酿材放入小桶酿造啤酒（3-7个游戏日）

⚙️ 数据驱动设计：
- 所有物品数据、配方和贴图均通过 Content Patcher JSON 定义
- 易于自定义和扩展[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Required:
- SMAPI 3.13.0 or later (https://smapi.io/)
- Content Patcher 2.0.0 or later (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915)

Required mods will be automatically detected and listed by Nexus Mods.

前置要求：
- SMAPI 3.13.0 或更高版本
- Content Patcher 2.0.0 或更高版本[/color]
